entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return these garbage cycling shoes I bought from you. This is unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's 7-4-Delta-9. And don't waste my time. These things gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. They're completely unusable.
I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry for the discomfort they've caused. Let me just pull up your order... Okay, I see the purchase was made about 70 days ago for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes.

That's right. 70 days of trying to make them work. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, tried every sock I own. They're defective. I demand a full refund, and if I don't get it, I'm going to light you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Is that clear?
That's perfectly clear, sir. And again, I do apologize for the trouble you've had. Please give me just one moment to verify the return eligibility.
Unbelievable. Just do your job. I want my money back.

Thank you for your patience. I've just confirmed our policy. Since you are within the 90-day return window for this item, I can go ahead and approve a full refund for you. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak.
Fine. It's about time. Make sure that refund processes immediately.
Absolutely. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
I will, sir. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
